The Commission shall meet at least twice a year
or at the call of the Executive Board.
tive Board, on the other hand, shall meet at least

It shall adopt rules and regulations

and to carry out the purposes or this Order.
The Executive Board is authorized to create
continuing or ad hoe committees consisting of the
members of the Commission or such other experts
as it may deem necessary, to conduct studies for
the Commission, or to assist it in the discharge
of its functions.
The Chairman or the Executive Board, in his
capacity as Secretary of Baucation, shall appoint
or hire the necessary technical, administrative
and clerical personnel to compose the technical
staff of the Commission.
He may also retain the
services of consultants for specific areas of work
